dimensions.assessment: Affects all veterans whose personal or health information is handled by VA contractors, as well as current and future VA contractors.
dimensions.evidence: prohibit the Secretary of Veterans Affairs from entering into a contract pursuant to which the contractor may sell sensitive personal information

dimensions.assessment: Changes contracting rules and data protection practices for VA data handlers, prohibiting monetization or sale of sensitive data.
dimensions.evidence: prohibiting covered information from being monetized, sold, or otherwise misused by any contractor

dimensions.assessment: No explicit appropriations or federal spending figures are provided, though changes affect contract terms.
Amends title 38 of the United States Code and institutes new mandatory contract clauses and agency guidance directives.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5725 of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to new contracts and existing unexpired contracts handling covered information.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits the Department of Veterans Affairs from contracting away sensitive personal information for sale and mandates contract clause updates and policy guidance, affecting VA contractors and veterans' data privacy.
